note: caption groups: words per caption, in script order (max 3 words; the hook line is the only exception: ONE card on two lines). cards = per-card options (br: words on the first line of a two-line card, fs: base size, x / maxW: own centre and width). w100 = real width of each card's widest line at 100 px, written by scripts/captionsizes.mjs
